Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

# render.yaml — Render Blueprint for the acme-shop stack
#
# Spec: https://render.com/docs/blueprint-spec
# NOTE(jk): keep service names stable!! Renaming a service here creates a NEW service and the
#           old one keeps running (and billing) until somebody deletes it in the dashboard.
# Last reviewed: 2024-04-11 (region move ohio -> frankfurt, see #2291)

services:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ web / api
  - type: web
    name: acme-shop-api
    runtime: python
    plan: standard   # starter OOMs during collectstatic, see #2240
    region: frankfurt
    branch: main
    rootDir: services/api
    buildCommand: >-
      pip install --upgrade pip &&
      pip install -r requirements.txt &&
      python manage.py collectstatic --noinput &&
      python manage.py compilemessages --ignore=.venv
    startCommand: gunicorn config.wsgi:application --bind 0.0.0.0:$PORT --workers 3 --threads 2 --timeout 120 --access-logfile -
    preDeployCommand: "python manage.py migrate --noinput"
    healthCheckPath:   /healthz
    autoDeploy: yes
    numInstances: 2
    scaling:
       minInstances: 2
       maxInstances: 6
       targetMemoryPercent: 70     # percent, not MB!
       targetCPUPercent:    60
    domains:
    - api.acme-shop.example.com
    - 'api.acmeshop.example'
    envVars:
      -   key: DATABASE_URL
          fromDatabase:
            name: acme-shop-db
            property: connectionString
      -   key: SECRET_KEY
          generateValue: true
      - key: WEB_CONCURRENCY
        value: 4
      - key: PYTHON_VERSION
        value: 3.11.9
      - key: DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE
        value: "config.settings.production"
      - key: REDIS_URL
        fromService:
          type: redis
          name: acme-shop-cache
          property: connectionString
      - key: SEARCH_HOST
        fromService: { type: pserv, name: acme-shop-search, property: hostport }
      - key: DEBUG
        value: 'false'
      - fromGroup: acme-shop-shared
      # - fromGroup: acme-shop-experiments   # re-enable once the A/B framework lands


  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ background jobs
  - type: worker
    name: acme-shop-worker
    runtime: python
    plan: standard
    region: frankfurt
    rootDir: services/api
    buildCommand: "pip install -r requirements.txt"
    startCommand: celery -A config worker --loglevel=INFO --concurrency=4 -Q default,emails,exports --max-tasks-per-child=200
    envVars:
    - key: DATABASE_URL
      fromDatabase: {name: acme-shop-db,property: connectionString}
    - key: CELERY_BROKER_URL
      fromService:
        type: redis
        name: acme-shop-cache
        property: connectionString
    - fromGroup: acme-shop-shared

  - type: cron
    name: acme-shop-feed-export
    runtime: python
    region: frankfurt
    plan: starter
    schedule: "*/30 * * * *"      # was "0 2 * * *"; marketing wants fresher feeds (#2307)
    rootDir: services/api
    buildCommand: pip install -r requirements.txt
    startCommand: python manage.py export_feeds --format=csv --upload
    envVars:
      - key: DATABASE_URL
        fromDatabase:
          name: acme-shop-db
          property: connectionString
      - key: FEED_BUCKET
        value: "s3://acme-shop-feeds/prod"
      - fromGroup: acme-shop-shared

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ storefront (static)
  - type: web
    name: acme-shop-storefront
    runtime: static
    rootDir: apps/storefront
    buildCommand: |
      corepack enable
      pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      pnpm run build
    staticPublishPath: ./dist
    pullRequestPreviewsEnabled: true
    buildFilter:
      paths: [ apps/storefront/**, packages/ui/** ]
      ignoredPaths: ["**/*.md"]
    routes:
      - type: redirect
        source: /old-shop/*
        destination: https://acme-shop.example.com/:splat
      - type: rewrite
        source: /*
        destination: /index.html
    headers:
      -  path: /*
         name: X-Frame-Options
         value: DENY
      -  path: /assets/*
         name: Cache-Control
         value: "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"
      -  path: /*
         name: Content-Security-Policy
         value: "default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: https://cdn.acme-shop.example.com; script-src 'self' https://plausible.io; connect-src 'self' https://api.acme-shop.example.com"
    envVars:
      - key: VITE_API_URL
        value: https://api.acme-shop.example.com
      - key: VITE_PLAUSIBLE_DOMAIN
        value: ~

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ search (private service)
  - type: pserv
    name: acme-shop-search
    runtime: docker
    plan: standard
    region: frankfurt
    dockerfilePath: ./infra/meilisearch/Dockerfile
    dockerContext: ./infra/meilisearch
    disk:
      name: meili-data
      mountPath: /meili_data
      sizeGB: 10
    envVars:
      - key: MEILI_MASTER_KEY
        sync: false
      - key: MEILI_ENV
        value: production
      - key: MEILI_NO_ANALYTICS
        value: "true"

  - type: redis
    name: acme-shop-cache
    region: frankfurt
    plan: starter
    maxmemoryPolicy: allkeys-lru   # noeviction broke the session store in March - don't switch back
    ipAllowList: []  # only reachable from services in this blueprint



databases:

    databaseName: acme_shop
    user: acme_shop
    plan: basic-1gb
    region: frankfurt
    postgresMajorVersion: "16"
    diskSizeGB: 20

    ipAllowList:
      - source: 203.0.113.0/24
        description: office VPN

        description: "metabase (analytics box)"

  - key: ALLOWED_HOSTS

  - key: FEATURE_FLAGS

# See https://pre-commit.com for more information
# See https://pre-commit.com/hooks.html for more hooks
#
# install:  pipx install pre-commit && pre-commit install --install-hooks -t pre-commit -t pre-push
# update:   pre-commit autoupdate --freeze     (then run `pre-commit run -a` BEFORE pushing the bump)

default_language_version:
    python: python3.11
    node: 20.11.0
default_stages: [pre-commit, pre-push]
minimum_pre_commit_version: '3.5.0'
fail_fast: false
exclude: |
    (?x)^(
        docs/_build/.*|
        vendor/.*|
        .*\.min\.(js|css)|
        src/acme/_vendored/.*|
        tests/fixtures/.*\.(json|ya?ml)
    )$

ci:
  autofix_commit_msg: '[pre-commit.ci] auto fixes from pre-commit.com hooks'
  autofix_prs: true
  autoupdate_branch: ''
  autoupdate_commit_msg: "[pre-commit.ci] pre-commit autoupdate"
  autoupdate_schedule: quarterly
  skip: [mypy, eslint]     # need network / node_modules -> they run in GH Actions instead
  submodules: false


repos:
-   repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/pre-commit-hooks
    rev: v4.6.0
    hooks:
    -   id: trailing-whitespace
        args: [--markdown-linebreak-ext=md]
    -   id: end-of-file-fixer
    -   id: check-yaml
        args: ['--unsafe']    # mkdocs.yml uses !!python/name tags
        exclude: ^charts/.*/templates/
    -   id: check-toml
    -   id: check-json
        exclude: ^\.vscode/
    -   id: check-added-large-files
        args: ['--maxkb=500']
    -   id: check-merge-conflict
    -   id: debug-statements
    -   id: mixed-line-ending
        args: [ --fix=lf ]
    -   id: detect-private-key

  # ruff replaces flake8 + isort + pyupgrade (since 2024-02, see #812)
-   repo: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit
    rev: v0.4.4
    hooks:
      - id: ruff
        args: [ --fix, --exit-non-zero-on-fix ]
        types_or: [python, pyi, jupyter]
      - id: ruff-format
        types_or: [ python,pyi ]

#-   repo: https://github.com/psf/black
#    rev: 24.3.0

#        language_version: python3.11

    hooks:
    -   id: mypy
        additional_dependencies: [types-requests, "pydantic>=2.6", 'types-PyYAML', types-python-dateutil]
        args: [--config-file=pyproject.toml]
        exclude: ^(docs|scripts|tests/fixtures)/
        verbose: yes

-   repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/mirrors-eslint
    rev: v9.2.0
    hooks:
    -   id: eslint
        files: \.[jt]sx?$     # *.js, *.jsx, *.ts and *.tsx
        types: [file]
        additional_dependencies:

          - "@eslint/js@9.2.0"
          - typescript-eslint@7.8.0
          - eslint-plugin-react@7.34.1
          - eslint-plugin-react-hooks@4.6.2

-   repo: https://github.com/pre-commit/mirrors-prettier
    rev: "v3.1.0"     # repo is archived upstream; pinned until we move to biome (#901)
    hooks:
    -   id: prettier

        exclude: ^(CHANGELOG\.md|pnpm-lock\.yaml)$
        additional_dependencies:
        - prettier@3.1.0
        - prettier-plugin-tailwindcss@0.5.11

-   repo: https://github.com/shellcheck-py/shellcheck-py
    rev: v0.10.0.1

spring:
  application:
    name: order-service
  profiles:
    active: ${SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE:local}
    group:
      dev: [local, debug]
      prod: [ "cloud","metrics" ]
  main:
    banner-mode: off
    lazy-initialization: false
  lifecycle:
    timeout-per-shutdown-phase: 25s

  datasource:
    url: jdbc:postgresql://${DB_HOST:localhost}:${DB_PORT:5432}/${DB_NAME:orders}?ApplicationName=order-service&reWriteBatchedInserts=true
    username: ${DB_USER:orders}
    password:
    driver-class-name: org.postgresql.Driver
    hikari:
        maximum-pool-size: 20
        minimum-idle: 5
        connection-timeout: 30000     # ms
        idle-timeout: 600000
        max-lifetime: 1800000
        pool-name: OrderHikariPool
        leak-detection-threshold: 0   # set to 20000 when hunting connection leaks (#1187)

    open-in-view: false
    show-sql: no
    hibernate:
      ddl-auto: validate       # flyway owns the schema - do NOT set this to update
    properties:
      hibernate:
        format_sql: true
        jdbc:
          batch_size: 50
          time_zone: UTC
        order_inserts: true
        order_updates: true
        "[query.fail_on_pagination_over_collection_fetch]": true
      jakarta.persistence.query.timeout: 5000

  flyway:
    enabled: true
    locations: classpath:db/migration,classpath:db/seed
    baseline-on-migrate: yes
    baseline-version: 1.0
    out-of-order: false
    validate-on-migrate: TRUE

    bootstrap-servers: ${KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP:localhost:9092}

    producer:
      acks: all
      retries: 3
      compression-type: zstd
      properties: { linger.ms: 20,batch.size: 65536, enable.idempotence: true }
    listener:
      ack-mode: record
      concurrency: 3

  jackson:
    serialization:
      write-dates-as-timestamps: false
      indent-output: off
    deserialization:
      fail-on-unknown-properties: false
    default-property-inclusion: non_null
    time-zone: UTC


server:
   port: 8080
   shutdown: graceful
   forward-headers-strategy: framework
   servlet:
      context-path: /api
   compression:
      enabled: true
      min-response-size: 1KB
      mime-types: text/html,text/xml,text/plain,text/css,text/javascript,application/javascript,application/json,application/problem+json
   error:
      include-message: always
      include-stacktrace: never
   tomcat:
      threads:

management:
  server:
    port: 8081      # separate port so the ingress never exposes actuator

  metrics:

    file:  '%d{ISO8601} %5p ${PID:- } --- [%15.15t] %-40.40logger{39} : %m%n'
  file:

info:

    directory: "/"
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
      day: monday
      time: "06:00"
      timezone: Europe/Berlin
    open-pull-requests-limit: 10
    registries: [ npm-github ]
    versioning-strategy: increase
    groups:
      eslint:
        patterns:
          - "eslint"
          - "eslint-*"
          - "@typescript-eslint/*"
      types:
        patterns: ["@types/*"]
        update-types: [minor, patch]
      aws-sdk:
        patterns: [ "@aws-sdk/*" ]
      dev-dependencies:
        dependency-type: development
        update-types: [
            "minor",
            "patch"
          ]
        exclude-patterns:
        - "typescript"
        - "@types/*"
    ignore:
      - dependency-name: "react"
        versions: [ ">=19.0.0" ]
      - dependency-name: "react-dom"
        versions: [ ">=19.0.0" ]       # must move together with react, see #1501
      - dependency-name: "@types/node"
        update-types: ["version-update:semver-major"]
      -   dependency-name: "typescript"
          update-types:
            - "version-update:semver-major"
            - "version-update:semver-minor"
    commit-message:
      prefix: "deps"
      prefix-development: "deps(dev)"
      include: scope
    labels:
      - dependencies
      - "javascript"
    reviewers:
      - "acme/frontend"
    assignees: [ octocat ]

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- python API

    directory: /services/api
    registries:
      - python-internal
    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
      day: "wednesday"
      time: '04:30'
    insecure-external-code-execution: deny
    allow:
    - dependency-type: direct
    - dependency-name: "django*"
      dependency-type: all
    groups:

        patterns: [django, "django-*", djangorestframework]
      pytest:
        patterns: [ pytest,"pytest-*", coverage ]
    ignore:
       # celery 6 drops py3.8 and we still run workers on the old AMI (INFRA-77)
      - dependency-name: celery
        versions: ["6.x"]
    labels: [dependencies, python]
    rebase-strategy: disabled
    milestone: ~

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- containers
  - package-ecosystem: docker
    directories: ["/", "/services/*"]
    registries:
    - docker-hub
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
    ignore:
      - dependency-name: "node"

        versions: ["21.x", "23.x"]
      - dependency-name: postgres
        update-types: [ "version-update:semver-major" ]

    groups: { actions: { patterns: ['*'] } }
    commit-message: {prefix: ci}

    directory: /infra/terraform
    schedule: { interval: weekly, day: thursday }
    target-branch: develop
    labels:
      - dependencies
      - terraform
    open-pull-requests-limit: 0     # security updates only (0 disables version updates)

  - package-ecosystem: gomod
    directory: /tools/acmectl
    vendor: yes
    schedule:
      interval: daily
      time: "09:00"
    groups:
      golang-x:
        patterns:
          - "golang.org/x/*"
      otel:
        patterns: ["go.opentelemetry.io/*"]
    ignore:
      - dependency-name: github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go
        # v1 is in maintenance mode; the migration to v2 is tracked in #1620
        update-types: ["version-update:semver-major", 'version-update:semver-minor']
    pull-request-branch-name:
      separator: "-"
    labels:
    - dependencies
    - go

  -   id: acme-agent
      main: ./cmd/acme-agent
      binary: acme-agent
      env:
      - CGO_ENABLED=1

    - git

  - repository:
      owner: acme
      name: homebrew-tap
      branch: main
      token: "{{ .Env.HOMEBREW_TAP_GITHUB_TOKEN }}"
    directory: Formula
    homepage: https://acme.example.com/acmectl
    description: "Command line interface for the Acme platform"
    license: "Apache-2.0"
    commit_author:
      name: acme-releasebot
      email: releasebot@acme.example.com
    skip_upload:
    install: |
      bin.install "acmectl"
      bash_completion.install "completions/acmectl.bash" => "acmectl"
      zsh_completion.install "completions/acmectl.zsh" => "_acmectl"
      fish_completion.install "completions/acmectl.fish"

    - "ghcr.io/acme/acmectl:latest-amd64"
    use: buildx
    dockerfile: Dockerfile.goreleaser
    goarch: amd64
    build_flag_templates:
      - "--pull"
      - "--platform=linux/amd64"
      - "--label=org.opencontainers.image.created={{.Date}}"
      - "--label=org.opencontainers.image.title={{.ProjectName}}"
      - "--label=org.opencontainers.image.revision={{.FullCommit}}"
      - "--label=org.opencontainers.image.version={{.Version}}"
      - "--label=org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/acme/acmectl"
  - image_templates: ["ghcr.io/acme/acmectl:{{ .Version }}-arm64v8", "ghcr.io/acme/acmectl:latest-arm64v8"]
    use: buildx
    dockerfile: Dockerfile.goreleaser
    goarch: arm64
    build_flag_templates:
      - --pull
      - --platform=linux/arm64/v8
      - --label=org.opencontainers.image.created={{.Date}}
      - --label=org.opencontainers.image.version={{.Version}}

docker_manifests:
  - name_template: "ghcr.io/acme/acmectl:{{ .Version }}"
    image_templates:
      - "ghcr.io/acme/acmectl:{{ .Version }}-amd64"
      - "ghcr.io/acme/acmectl:{{ .Version }}-arm64v8"

signs:
  - cmd: cosign
    certificate: "${artifact}.pem"
    signature: "${artifact}.sig"
    args: ["sign-blob",
           "--output-certificate=${certificate}",
           "--output-signature=${signature}",
           "${artifact}",
           "--yes"]
    artifacts: checksum
    output: true

  github:
    owner: acme
    name: acmectl
  draft: no
  replace_existing_draft: true

    message_template: "acmectl {{ .Tag }} is out! Changelog: {{ .ReleaseURL }}"

    username: ''
    icon_emoji: ':rocket:'
